hypotheses.rationale: Consistent early morning routine (07:15-07:52) and evening return (~18:40-19:00) on weekdays strongly support a standard workday. Day 10 (Thursday) fits this pattern perfectly.
Slight variation in morning start times (07:15 vs 07:52) leaves a tiny possibility of flexibility, but the rigid evening return and lack of midday laptop usage make this unlikely.
Contradicted by consistent morning activity on Days 7, 8, 9, and 10. Night shift workers would not be active at 07:00-08:00 on consecutive days.

notes: Day 10 (Thursday) confirms the pattern: morning activity at 07:50 (similar to Tuesday) and evening activity at 19:00. The 08:40 departure on Wednesday was a key discriminator for the 9-5 schedule. No evidence of remote work (e.g., laptop at desk during day) or night shift. Hypothesis 3 is now effectively discarded (p=0.0). Need to verify if object_18 is moved on Thursday morning to confirm departure pattern.
